entities.name: Lazare Lévy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lazare Lévy, also hyphenated as Lazare-Lévy, was an influential French pianist, organist, composer and pedagogue. As a virtuoso pianist he toured throughout Europe, in North Africa, Israel, the Soviet Union and Japan. He taught for many years at the Paris Conservatoire.
